overviews.title: What is VLSI Design?: Course Fees 2026, Subjects, Top Colleges, Admissions

blocks.value: VLSI full form in Engineering, is 'Very Large Scale Integration', which falls under the broad umbrella of Electronics Engineering. Its courses are dedicated to making powerful integrated circuits (ICs) with billions of transistors put together in a minimal area of a chip to power powerful electronic devices that rule the world at present.

The VLSI Design syllabus covers important subjects like Digital Electronics, Network Analysis and Synthesis, Electromagnetic Wave and Field Theory, VLSI Design Processing Technology, Microprocessors, Embedded Systems Design, and more.

The basic course eligibility for UG courses is completing Class 12 in the Science background with at least 50 to 60% marks in PCM. For PG courses, you need to have a UG degree in ECE, Electronics Engineering or a related field with at least 55 to 60% marks.

The admission process for VLSI courses is based on both Class 12 merit and entrance exam scores. Some VLSI entrance exams in India are GATE , AP PGECET, CEETA, JEE Main, JEE Advanced, KCET, and CUET PG. You'll find more than 800 VLSI Design colleges in India.
If interested, you can continue reading the article for more details on VLSI Engineering courses.

faqs.question: Does VLSI Design course require coding?
faqs.answer: Coding is an important skill for VLSI design engineers. They define the behavior and structure of digital circuits using hardware description languages (HDLs) . HDLs are programming languages created specifically for VLSI design. HDLs are used by VLSI engineers to model digital circuits before they are synthesized and manufactured. faqs.question: Which is better to study: Embedded systems or VLSI design?
faqs.answer: If you are interested in software development and designing systems that control and monitor specific functions in a device, then embedded systems may be a good fit for you. If you are interested in hardware design and designing the chips that power electronic devices, then VLSI design may be a good fit for you. In case, you are looking to choose without any core individual interest as such then, here is a table that summarizes the key differences between embedded systems and VLSI design Feature Embedded systems VLSI design Role Embedded systems are computer systems that are designed to perform specific tasks in a larger system. They are found in a wide range of devices, including cars, airplanes, medical devices, and consumer electronics. Embedded systems engineers design, develop, and test these systems. VLSI design is the process of designing integrated circuits (ICs), also known as chips. ICs are used in almost all electronic devices. VLSI engineers use hardware description languages (HDLs) to design ICs, and they then work with fabrication companies to manufacture the chips. faqs.question: Which has higher income jobs in India-Analog VLSI Design or Digital VLSI Design?
faqs.answer: Analog VLSI design jobs tend to have higher salaries than digital VLSI design jobs in India. According to AmbitionBox, the average salary for an analog design engineer in India is INR 15.9 Lacs per year , while the average salary for a digital design engineer is INR 8.6 Lacs per year. This is a fairly big difference in the remunerations and one could easily explain that the analog design jobs are more difficult and in high demand. Besides, salary may depend upon many factors including experience, skills and the company where one works. For instance, a well experienced analog design engineer working with the reputable semiconductor firm can be paid INR 25 Lacs per annum or even more .
